notes: Allows rc.8 to create a genesis deployment anchor for a currently reviewed first-start migration from v1.2.0, v1.2.0-rc.6, or v1.3.0-rc.1 only when exact migration, backup, identity, activation, verification, version, and commit evidence agree.
Creates and validates the genesis anchor before publishing the active-machine pointer, so enrollment rejection or interruption cannot leave an apparently active machine without deployment authority.
Keeps ordinary startup fail-closed: a missing or deleted anchor cannot be recreated even by the same rc.8 commit, and unsupported source releases cannot request genesis enrollment.

Adds an isolated exact-tag rehearsal for each legacy cohort using its original updater, a locked reviewed source, independent cancellation and activation destinations, exact config comparison, and second-checkout reuse.

The bundled firmware is byte-identical to v1.3.0-rc.7: 367968 bytes with SHA-256 1FEC7C6C8D3C0022844695CDF51A860539BCFBDA291BB18C12A99062C7A32577. Direct legacy upgrades must deploy and verify this exact artifact.

requires_firmware.note: Firmware bytes are unchanged from rc.7. Legacy-source machines must deploy and verify the exact rc.7/rc.8 artifact; the application updater does not establish installed-firmware provenance.

summary: Corrected release candidate for activation-only direct legacy migration and exact-tag rollout rehearsal.
